newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand scrambles to find new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Thailand scrambles to find new finance minister.

text.p: Three technocrats were seen as possible replacements for Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan who resigned from the government on Thursday, government sources said.

Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh had approached Olarn Chaipravat, president of Siam Commercial Bank, former finance minister Viraphongsa Ramangura, and Export-Import Bank chief Pridiyathorn Devakul, a source told Reuters.
But sources close to Olarn, a leading economist and former central banker, told Reuters that Olarn had turned down the offer. He was on a business trip to Germany.
Viraphongsa and Pridiyathorn could not be immediately reached for comment.
Amnuay tendered his resignation on Thursday after losing a battle over a plan to rise excise taxes for some consumer items.
He had proposed the tax increase because the current economic downturn had caused a shortfall in government revenue.
But his political rivals in the six-party coalition government managed to get the cabinet to reverse the decision.
Amnuay lost face and decided to quit, political sources said.
